'''Amadaine 22 (June 30)'''

==Events==
* [[998 NE]] - [[Bayle Domon]] is captured by the [[Seanchan]] near [[Falme]]. He is taken to [[Turak Aladon|High Lord Turak]] and forced to give him his [[Seal]].
* [[998 NE]] - [[Geofram Bornhald]] takes his legion to [[Toman Head]].
* [[999 NE]] - [[Elayne]] and [[Nynaeve]] enter the [[Panarch's Palace]]. Elayne rescues [[Amathera]], while Nynaeve duels and defeats [[Moghedien]]. They take the Seal and the [[Domination Band|Sad Bracelets]], but Moghedien escapes. Bayle Domon and [[Egeanin]] take the Sad Bracelets for dumping in the ocean near the [[Aile Somera]].
* [[999 NE]] - The final attack by [[Trollocs]] on [[Emond's Field]] is fought with aid from [[Deven Ride]] and [[Watch Hill]]. The [[Whitecloaks]] leave the [[Two Rivers]], followed by [[Ordeith]] (Padan Fain).
</noinclude>
